tex_content.html:
Proposition
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0071, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0072, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0073 1. Proposition 2.42\group neckpinch

There exist smooth rotationally symmetric initial metrics on $S^{n+1}$ with $|\Psi _s|\le 1$, positive scalar curvature, and a sufficiently small neck so that the Ricci flow develops a neckpinch in finite time.
